## Executive Summary

Welcome to my portfolio! I build end-to-end data science solutions specializing in **predictive maintenance**, **real-time operational telemetry**, and **cost-optimization frameworks**. 

This portfolio demonstrates a complete industrial data science lifecycle across three core projects:

1. **Failure Prediction (ML Pipeline):** Forecasting Remaining Useful Life (RUL) from multi-sensor time-series telemetry, validated on a held-out test set.
2. **Operational Telemetry (Streaming UI):** Building real-time interactive dashboards with dynamic anomaly alerting.
3. **Business Impact (Decision Engine):** Translating real model predictions into optimal financial policies that minimize total operational expenditure ($OPEX$).

See the [Methodology & Limitations](projects/methodology.qmd) page for how these projects connect and where their current constraints are.
